guards: Six older locally matched fixes resolved without regressing last-driven time
road_metadata.limits: Adds exact comparisons and bindings to avoid unchanged writes. Trigger events are row-operation evidence, not measured Android disk bytes or battery. Grouping, visit recounting, point resolution, transactions and generation checks remain.

isolated_sqlite_wal.limits: Only affected statements in a local SQLite fixture, with SQL metadata columns read from current source. Not an Android filesystem, latency, physical-device battery, whole-app or fleet-capacity measurement.

csv_restore.row_buffer_allocation: One cleared ContentValues per CSV table replaces one per record.
csv_restore.limits: Allocation reduction follows the loop structure; no allocation profiler or device speed percentage. All conversions, validation, checksums, limits, cancellation, transactions and reset protections remain.

notification_digest.algorithm_and_encoding: SHA-256 over the same UTF-8 bytes, lowercase hexadecimal
notification_digest.limits: Format construction count from source, not a physical-device benchmark. Stored values, account binding and all consent/registration rules are unchanged.

checks: Never-finishing cleanup does not delay failure
rejected_notification_oauth.limits: Releases unused network resources, without removing authorization attempts, changing credentials/expiry or claiming a provider-quota saving. No production Google requests were made.

additional_scopes: Bounds, geometry keys and segment IDs

limits: No guaranteed physical-device battery percentage, whole-app speedup, DAU capacity or daily driving-hour increase.
